itemized.notes: 2022 form 'Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate'; September 15 interim report, not an amendment; signed 9/14/2022. County Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p4) are blank stubs reading 'See attached'; the filer's own ruled spreadsheet tables carry the detail. Address/City/State/Zip columns are bar-redacted at source on every attachment row, so donor_city/donor_state are blank throughout. Other Campaign Accounts section (pp5-7) entirely blank. Duplicate donor rows on p9 (Larry/Lawrence Barusch) and p10 (Dinesh Shetty x2, Richard Justice x2) are printed as-is and included in the printed TOTAL, which closes exactly with them. Audit prior said p9 has 34 rows and p10 39 - confirmed at the page.
